speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Vocal Cord Dysfunction (Paradoxical Vocal Fold Motion). The presentation of stridor and wheezing triggered by crying or feeding, without the classic "whoop" of pertussis or the specific failure to thrive seen in severe obstructive lung diseases, along with the need to rule out structural issues via laryngoscopy, points toward this functional disorder. The initial workup for cystic fibrosis and alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency is appropriate but less likely given the activity-specific nature of the symptoms.
